title: Non-associativity: sum orderings vs high-precision ref (real C++)
info: the fixture is fixed by the driver (no rand()/time()): one large value followed by 100000 copies of 1.0f, chosen so float32 addition provably drops every one of them in forward order
every accumulator in the 4 orderings must stay float32 -- only the separate high-precision reference sum may use double
